startupReadRace.method: Real stored Sofle row and scoped active-project preference; native IndexedDB projects.get success callback was held once by the generic test observer. Before release, the public REVIUNG demo button imported/opened the REVIUNG copy. Worker trace showed only that explicit archive import and one Core Open for document edbec892-9952-4b6b-a7ba-cb6b0a514ac4 (revision 3). Releasing the real Sofle get callback left REVIUNG active and caused no late Sofle Core Open.

coreWasmReadiness.method: Separate fresh profile without the IDB callback observer. After saving Sofle, the owned no-service-worker server held the real core-worker WASM fetch during reload. While held, startup remained in the library and the generic worker trace had no Core request. Releasing the exact staged response produced core-ready, then Core Open for m1-sofle-v2-copy revision 3, then scene reply; the editor reached Saved.

caseScopeAndCancellation.delayedGenerationCancellation: PASS; on Sofle Left PCB / Canonical, public Generate reached Core resolve/prepare, then the server held the actual CAD-worker WASM fetch. Selecting physical left half and switching to Right PCB changed scope, reset instance to Canonical board, displayed 'Case generation cancelled', terminated the old CAD worker, and left no case canvas. Releasing the staged WASM produced no stale result or canvas.
